page.title: Assistant
page.subtitle: Natural-language questions about your data · read-only, with your permissions
page.how1: The model only has access to 7 read tools (search, KPIs, open invoices, orders, presence, leave, low stock).
page.how2: Each tool queries the database with your session: RLS applies, so the assistant cannot see salaries if you cannot.
page.how3: It changes nothing: it suggests a link to the page where you can act in one click.
page.how4: In the inbox, it writes reply drafts for you to review before sending.

suggestions.orders: What is the status of the pro orders being prepared?

chat.notConfiguredHint: Add ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to crm/.env.local then restart pnpm dev. Nothing is simulated here: no key, no answer.
chat.intro: Ask a question about your data. The assistant reads the database with your permissions and changes nothing.
